props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: items
props.description: Array of avatars to render in the group.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum number of avatars to show.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: alt
props.description: Accessible alt text for the avatar.

props.name: badgePosition
props.description: Position of the badge relative to the avatar.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon name shown in place of `text` while the image is unavailable.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Callback when the loading status of the avatar changes.

props.name: src
props.description: Source URL for the avatar image.

props.name: text
props.description: Initial text to show if image fails or is missing.
